notes.title: Fractaltopia Going Free!
notes.content:
Hello all,
I will be making Fractaltopia free. I have not been active with this project for some time, and some of the Unity files for it are corrupt. This would make providing further updates a very time consuming process that I cannot fulfill at the moment. Enjoy!
-Jesse

notes.title: Update #2: Mandelbrot Zoom & Bug Fixes + 25% off sale!
notes.content:
[u][b]Fractaltopia[/b][/u] just now had its 2nd update! This update features the new Mandelbrot Set Zoom, as well as bug fixes. Not only that, but there will be a [b]25% off sale[/b]. It has never been a better time to pick up Fractaltopia! 

The Mandelbrot Set Zoom feature will include your iteration count, fps, and zoom multiplier. You are able to increase/decrease iterations and zoom up to 50,000x.

If you haven't already, head over to the Singularity Horizons discord where you can suggest new features, report bugs, and keep up to date on the latest progress notes.

http://www.discord.gg/vNVtGGEwcG

25% off sale (Apr 27 10:00am PST - May 3 10:00 PST)

notes.title: Vote for new features!
notes.content:
Hello,

Now that Fractaltopia has been out for a few months, I have compiled a list of issues/bugs that I am currently working to fix. On top of that, I have a polls section over on the discord for new features, as well as a suggestions channel for those looking to decide on the next feature. Head on over and check it out if you are interested!

http://www.discord.gg/vNVtGGEwcG

Thank you,
Jesse
